BiblicalUsage: Elishah is a son of Javan. In Genesis 10:4, the text says "Elishah." The life behind the name is told on the Elishah People profile.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Elishah matters because God knows His people by name, and Elishah is one of them. That is why I want the name, and the person behind it, kept straight.
